name: plugpup-salestax
description: Add sales tax to a price or take it out of a tax-inclusive total for any US state. Uses each state's current base rate plus its average local rate, or your exact rate if you give it (either the city/county part or the total combined rate), and shows the full breakdown. Average local rates are an estimate: your city or county rate may differ, so give your exact local rate for an exact figure. Clear notes for no-sales-tax states.
